title: Omniview Triage Slateboard: Unified Payload + Retry Flow Prototype
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design a unified 'Omniview Triage Slateboard' inside Redwood Console that surfaces failed requests, retry flows, and a compact error taxonomy with inline payload diffs. The slateboard is an entry point for on-call and SRE users to rapidly triage incidents, replay retries in a sandbox, and link rollouts or model switches back to request impact metrics.
background: We currently have multiple fragmented debug UIs (request timelines, payload diffs, replay-only flows). Customers asked for a single surface that combines failed-request context, retry history, and rollout correlation so engineers can answer: 'Which rollout/model/version caused the spike?', 'Did retries change payloads?', and 'What is the cheapest mitigation?'. Past designs focused on deep exploratory tools; this slateboard prioritizes fast remediation and low cognitive overhead.
goals: Provide a single-pane triage view combining timeline, retry waterfall, and payload diff lanes
Make error taxonomy visible and actionable (group by class, frequency, and affected rollout)
Enable safe sandboxed retry replay with KV-cache toggles and lineage isolation
Surface cost/regression signals next to failed requests to support quick rollback decisions
user_stories: As an SRE, I want to see failed requests grouped by error class and rollout so I can identify suspect releases quickly.
As an engineer, I want to replay a single failed request in a sandbox with the same model variant and KV-cache state so I can reproduce the failure without affecting production.
As a PM, I want to view token-level cost delta for retries versus baseline to decide whether to enable degraded-mode on a rollout.
As an on-call, I want inline payload diffs between retry attempts to detect mutated inputs that may trigger failures.
design_notes: Slateboard merges three mini-panels: Incident Snapshot (top), Retry Waterfall (center), Payload Diff Lanes (bottom)
Error taxonomy badges use color and compact counts; clicking a badge filters the waterfall and payload lanes
Retry sandbox includes toggles for KV cache (cold/warm), temperature/params snapshot, and a read-only simulated cost estimator
Motion prototype emphasizes progressive disclosure: default collapsed payload preview, expand to full diff only on demand
Accessibility: ensure high contrast badges and keyboard-first navigation for triage workflows
acceptance_criteria: Single-incident entry loads in <2s with up to 200 associated request traces
Clicking an error taxonomy badge filters waterfall and payload lanes consistently
Sandbox replay runs against a non-production routing path and returns deterministic logs to the UI
Payload diff shows tokenized highlights and can collapse to a one-line preview for long payloads
Cost delta displayed per-retry with an explanation tooltip for token counting method
tasks: Finalize Figma screens for Incident Snapshot, Retry Waterfall, and Payload Diff Lanes
Align with runtime team on sandbox replay API contract and KV-cache toggle semantics
Prototype sandbox replay hooks and display simulated cost estimator
Write spec for error taxonomy mapping from runtime logs to UI badges
Implement keyboard nav and a11y checks for triage keyboard flows
Prepare handoff package and review notes for Eng and PM

decisions: Use compact error taxonomy badges (class, severity, affected-rollout) instead of long lists to reduce cognitive load
Sandbox replay will be read-only for production data and use a shadow routing path; live impactful actions (rollback) gated behind PM approvals
Cost estimator in UI will use token-count approximation and link to detailed billing page for exact numbers
